mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 5% indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a quarter signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy combined with slow economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal savings (RSAFS) combined with an increase in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates reduced consumer purchasing power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 3% for two consecutive months signals strong economic activity, which is a positive indicator for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 3% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.
